source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Against a PSYKER target, apply [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] on a Critical Wound. Bypass saves and deal the attack’s Damage as mortal wounds, counting [MELTA] and any Damage bonus from the Critical Wound. Resolve this after ordinary damage. Excess stays off other models. Feel No Pain can still prevent wounds, including rolls limited to mortal wounds.

effect.mortalWounds: attack Damage including Melta and critical-wound Damage bonuses

detail.feelNoPain: applies, including mortal-only Feel No Pain
